Étape 1Logarithme des deux membres⟦(25^{x})^{2} = 5^{0} \cdot 5^{x + 3}⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦\log((25^{x})^{2}) = \log(5^{0} \cdot 5^{x + 3})⟧(log des deux membres)⟦\iff⟧⟦\log((25^{x})^{2}) = \log(5^{0}) + \log(5^{x + 3})⟧(log(ab) = log a + log b)⟦\iff⟧⟦2x \cdot \log(25) = (x + 3) \cdot \log(5)⟧(log(a^A) = A · log(a))⟦\iff⟧⟦2x \cdot \log(25) = x \cdot \log(5) + 3\log(5)⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦x(2\log(25) - \log(5)) = 3\log(5)⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦x = \frac{3\log(5)}{2\log(25) - \log(5)}⟧(car ⟦2\log(25) - \log(5) \neq 0⟧)⟦\phantom{x} = \frac{\log(125)}{\log(125)}⟧(propriétés des logarithmes)⟦\phantom{x} = 1⟧⟦3\log(5) = \log(5^{3})⟧(propriétés des logarithmes)⟦\phantom{3\log(5)} = \log(125)⟧⟦2\log(25) - \log(5) = \log\left(\frac{25^{2}}{5}\right)⟧(propriétés des logarithmes)⟦\phantom{2\log(25) - \log(5)} = \log(125)⟧
Solution⟦S = \left\{1\right\}⟧
